description: 0.3.0 target architecture. Map 0 accepted by the owner; submaps and detailed contracts are provisional. Arrows are calls including their declared response, except explicitly named guidance/data/event arrows. No transitive access. Only 5 exposes shared part state; each other component may exclusively own private state. No source compliance has been established. Extension resource access added by owner request: Thingi10K belongs in Extensions, with an explicit external-resource wire. Extensions are unsandboxed local code; contracts describe intended SAAM/reviewed-extension structure, not confinement of arbitrary scripts. Owner confirmed preservation of a simplified Studio–agent channel, priority event batches and exclusive per-bundle editing; saved artifacts remain inspectable without regeneration dependencies. Specialized workspaces are external bundle producers with public engine access; handoff is one-way and does not grant confirmation authority.
